data.cancellation_notes:
**Tour Cancellation Policy**

Please notify us at sales@unlimitedbiking.com at least 24 hours in advance if you cannot make your tour. 

For any cancellations within 24 hours of the tour, we can provide a full credit in the amount you have paid towards bike rentals that will never expire!

Please note: If you reschedule your booking for a later date, we must receive your cancellation request 24 hours before your original travel date. If you reschedule for an earlier date, the 24 hour cancellation window applies to your new travel date.
data.booking_notes:
### Departure Location:
**Unlimited Biking: San Diego**
330 K Street
San Diego, CA 92101**

Please try to arrive 10-15 minutes before your tour's starting time to check in with our team and meet your guide! Your outfit should be seasonally suitable; we also suggest that you dress in something comfy, not too loose, and closed-toe shoes. Don't forget a proper ID and your camera!

Learn the history of the Gaslamp Quarter before heading toward the beautiful views of the Embarcadero.
See all the downtown gems including the USS Midway, the Greatest Generation Walk, Billionaire Row, Tuna Pier and more!
Explore all that Balboa Park has to offer like the Japanese Friendship Garden and Casa del Prado
Boost your experience with an electric bike for a leisurely ride

For questions or concerns, please email sales@unlimitedbiking.com.
